subject: Post-call recap: procurement path options & billing trigger for Finovo trial
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Kim <sasha@finovo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement path options & billing trigger for Finovo trial

Hi Sasha — thanks again for today’s call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of call:
- Finovo wants to run a 3-week technical trial focused on latency-sensitive document parsing and reranking.
- Primary success criteria: 95%+ extraction accuracy on sample set; tail latency under 250ms P50 for typical requests; cost target ~ $0.008/token equivalent for baseline workload.
- Procurement constraint: procurement team prefers PO for recurring spend but Finovo engineering can put a corporate card for the trial if needed to speed the start.

Options we discussed (please confirm preferred):
1) Fast-start (card): start trial within 48 hours. Billing would start on the first day of trial for any billable usage; we can convert to PO later and issue credits for overlap if needed.
2) PO-first (paper path): Finovo raises a PO and we invoice monthly. Typical internal processing for similar customers is 10–15 business days.
3) Marketplace (AWS/GCP): Finovo purchases via cloud marketplace to simplify billing and procurement; roadmap-dependent — marketplace listing would add ~2 weeks to setup.

Proposed trial plan (attached spreadsheet):
- Kick: whichever payment path you confirm (we can still start onboarding before PO clears if you choose PO route).
- Success tests: run 3 evaluation prompts + 2 production-like bulk runs; we’ll score accuracy and latency and provide a leaderboard.
- Billing trigger: billing transitions to paid subscription when trial period ends OR when you opt-in to start paid early (we can set a clear calendar date).

Action items for Finovo:
- Confirm preferred procurement path (card / PO / marketplace) and expected PO approval date if PO.
- Confirm trial start target date (suggest Wed 7/7 or Mon 7/12).
- Send sample dataset and success criteria doc.

Internal action items (Marissa / Nikhil):
- Marissa: prep the onboarding checklist and fill in expected infra needs.
- Nikhil: prepare a short SOW and a billing fallback note for PO->card conversion accounting.

Attachments: redwood-trial-plan-3w.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-draft.pdf (stub)

Thanks — I’ll hold 30 minutes on Wed for a quick kick if you want to start 7/7.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | developer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0173
From: Sasha Kim <sasha@finovo.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finovo Procurement <procurement@finovo.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement path options & billing trigger for Finovo trial

Thanks Karthik — useful recap. Quick responses from our side: 

- Preferred path: Procurement preference is PO-first for anything expected to convert to a contract. Procurement team is copied here and will start the internal intake.
- Timeline: procurement estimates ~12 business days for PO approval (we’ll flag this as expedited).
- For speed we will have Engineering place a corporate card for initial onboarding and smoke tests, but we will not accept charged production usage on the card — only validation runs.
- Marketplace: interested but we’d prefer not to add that complexity for the pilot.

Trial start target: we’d like onboarding to start this week for validation (card), and switch to paid billing after the PO is issued and effective. Can Redwood provide a credit policy for usage between the card start and PO effective date?

Dataset and success criteria: I’ll upload the sample set by EOD and share a short doc with expected extraction labels.

Sasha
VP Product, Finovo
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Kim <sasha@finovo.com>, Finovo Procurement <procurement@finovo.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: procurement path options & billing trigger for Finovo trial

On Mon, Jul 6, 2026 at 09:30 AM Sasha Kim <sasha@finovo.com> wrote:
> For speed we will have Engineering place a corporate card for initial onboarding and smoke tests, but we will not accept charged production usage on the card — only validation runs.

Thanks Sasha — that approach makes sense and mirrors what we do with other proof-of-concept customers. A few clarifications from our side so procurement and finance are aligned: 

- Credit policy: Redwood can issue an on-account credit for any trial usage billed to the corporate card from trial kick to PO effective date, up to an agreed cap of $2,500 unless Procurement requests a different amount. We’ll handle any credit as a post-invoice adjustment (invoice issued for card, then credit applied when PO is active).
- PO conversion: when PO becomes active we’ll switch billing to invoice terms per the PO and reconcile any credits.
- Trial to paid trigger: default: billing starts on the PO effective date. If Finovo explicitly elects to begin paid earlier, we’ll start billing on that chosen date (we recommend marking this in writing).

Nikhil — I drafted a short SOW and a billing note; attaching SOW-draft.pdf. Karthik — I’ll also update the onboarding sheet with infra estimates and a suggested check-in cadence (wk0: integration, wk1: scoring, wk2: production-ish load).

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Kim <sasha@finovo.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Final confirmation: billing transition rules & PO logistics (Finovo / RDW-4721)

Hi all — following up with the final finance/legal position so procurement can proceed: 

- Credit cap: confirmed $2,500 cap for card-billed validation runs before PO effective date. Any usage beyond that will be invoiced unless Procurement requests a higher cap in writing.
- Invoice reconciliation: once PO is active, Redwood will apply credits as a line item credit on the first invoice.
- PO metadata we need from Finovo to map the PO to the deal: PO number, effective date, billing contact, purchase order PDF (please upload to the HubSpot link below).
- Marketplace: note that marketplace purchases route billing through the cloud provider and change resale/right-to-audit terms — Finovo should tell us if they prefer that path once PO cadence is confirmed.

Next steps (short):
- Sasha: please confirm PO expected approval date and upload PO PDF to https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4721.
- Karthik: schedule the onboarding 30-min kickoff for Wed 7/7 at 10am PT (we’ll put calendar hold).
- Marissa: finalize SOW and onboarding checklist; I’ll sign off from finance side.

If procurement needs any additional standard forms (W-9, vendor questionnaire) we can push those today.

Thanks — Nikhil
Billing & Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
